rows.v_note: FY2025 ended June 30, 2025: USD 1,688 million, calculated as egg-based vaccines 116 + cell-culture vaccines 474 + adjuvanted egg-based vaccines 901 + pre-pandemic sales 197 (all USD million). Excludes pandemic reservation fees, other/in-license revenue and other income; USD bn.
